name: The Shack Summer Camp
description_short: Glen Rock recreation day camp for residents ages 7 to 14, held Monday to Thursday at Wilde Memorial Park and on Fridays at Children's Park and the Glen Rock Pool. Weekly or full six week sign up.

fees.name: Pool day pass (Fridays)
fees.note: Cash, only for campers without a Glen Rock pool membership.

notes: Residents only. $75 per child per week or $375 for the full six weeks. Drop off 9 am, pick up 3 pm; no camp Friday July 3. Campers may bring lunch; a refrigerator at The Shack stores lunches (none on Fridays). Session price is the full six week rate.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp page; it prints no year. Dates June 29 to August 7 with no camp Friday July 3
Researched by Claude from this page. Glen Rock's registration site, linked from the camp page, lists the program as 2026 Shack Summer Camp (weekly and full camp), which sets the season year
